citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany the APHIS Official during the inspection process at 3:40pm on
Monday, July 27, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee and was told by a family member at the facility
that the licensee was not available and would not be for the remainder of the evening, as they had family plans. Failure to
provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued
failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
